text:
sam-cs: customer reports intermittent failures: their streaming tool_call arrives as truncated JSON and our validator returns 400 / JSONDecodeError. Happens about 1-3% of tool_call streams, more with big nested metadata.

customer-rep: here's what they're seeing in our logs (redacted):
```
{"tool":"charge","args":{"amount":4999,"currency":"USD","items":[{"id":"SKU-123","qty":1}],"metadata":{"cart_id":"CART-7X","notes":"..."...
```
They say the connection closed or the client stopped sending before the closing braces.

jen-support: which SDK + transport? any request-id + headers from the failing traces?

customer-rep: request id rwd-req-2026-03-16-8b2f, SDK: node-streaming-client v2.5. Headers: Accept: text/event-stream, Content-Type: application/json, Transfer-Encoding: chunked, User-Agent: RedwoodNode/2.5, X-Request-Id: rwd-req-2026-03-16-8b2f

deploy-bot: ERROR rwd-req-2026-03-16-8b2f 11:03:12Z runtime: schema validation failed: JSONDecodeError("Expecting ',' delimiter: line 1 column 234") => 400

matt-eng: two likely culprits: 1) intermediate L7 (ALB/nginx) or client's own HTTP stack is splitting up the JSON so our parser sees incomplete fragments. 2) our SSE/frame parser might be attempting to validate per-chunk instead of reassembling.

kevin-infra: customer path: AWS ALB -> nginx ingress -> our edge. ALB+nginx combos have produced split-chunk behavior before when proxy_buffering or chunk tuning differs. I need a pcap / ALB logs to confirm.

customer-rep: provided ALB logs and timestamps in the ticket.

matt-eng: quick repro I used locally (python):
```
# stream a JSON in two writes to simulate a split chunk
import socket, ssl
s = socket.socket()
ssl_sock = ssl.wrap_socket(s)
ssl_sock.connect(('staging-api.redwood.com', 443))
req = 'POST /v1/stream?mode=tool_call HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: staging-api.redwood.com\\r\\nAccept: text/event-stream\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\\r\\n\\r\\n'
ssl_sock.send(req.encode())
part1 = '{"tool":"charge","args":{"amount":2500,'
ssl_sock.send(hex(len(part1))[2:].encode()+b"\r\n"+part1.encode()+b"\r\n")
# pause, then send rest as another chunk
# simulate network split

```
This reliably triggers our JSONDecodeError if runtime tries to parse per-chunk.

jen-support: customer needs a short-term mitigation they can apply today.

sam-cs: recommended workarounds: 1) switch their checkout tool_call to a non-streaming RPC so the full JSON arrives in one request; 2) tune their ALB/nginx ingress to avoid splitting (see infra snippet); 3) add client-side buffering so they send the body in one write.

kevin-infra: nginx suggestions that often help:
```
proxy_request_buffering off;
proxy_buffer_size 128k;
proxy_buffers 4 256k;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
proxy_busy_buffers_size 256k;
```
Also ensure any gzip or request-rewriting middleware is disabled for the stream endpoint.

matt-eng: longer-term runtime fixes: buffer incoming SSE/event-stream bytes per-request until a full JSON object is present. Options: bracket-balanced detector, small streaming JSON parser, or add an explicit length-prefixed event envelope. We'll implement a guard so we don't throw 400 on partial parse; instead respond 102/202 while awaiting completion and only validate once the object is complete.

jen-support: ETA? customer is P1 (checkout failing intermittently).

matt-eng: created INF-1184, assigned to eng-runtime. Plan: 1) add defensive buffering + non-fatal handling to avoid immediate 400s (hotfix) -> staging within 24h; 2) full parser fix to correctly reassemble SSE chunks -> prod rollout in 48-72h. If they need immediate relief, recommend non-streamed calls for 48h.

kevin-infra: I'll produce an ingress patch and example ALB config together with a checklist to disable any L7 buffering at the customer gateway. Also requesting the specific request-id/time window to pull a pcap from our edge logs.

customer-rep: gave timestamps, ALB log links, and consent to run diagnostics. Marked customer as high-priority.

matt-eng: followups: add unit/integration tests that simulate split-chunk SSE frames with nested JSON; add logging that captures trimmed partial-chunk samples (PII-filtered) to help triage.

sam-cs: keeping P0 until workaround or hotfix applied. Will update ticket INF-1184 with customer feedback and close thread after staging verification. :thumbsup:
